law: G4 (owner plan 2026-11-13): fixed workflows run as machine contracts against the built wheel in a disposable workspace with a local bare origin. Measures per journey: approvals (owner consents, exact baseline) and blocked (every Kit step ends PASS or PLANNED; baseline 0). A worse measure fails CI. Offline the journeys stop at the GitHub boundary (work finish as dry run).

journeys.title: Start work, change a file, finish
